title: What if your house had no foundation?

shots.text: This house is sinking into the ground.
Because it was built with no foundation.
A normal house stands on concrete footings that reach down to hard, solid ground.
Without them, the whole weight of the house presses on soft dirt.
Every time it rains, that dirt gets even softer...
and one side starts sinking faster than the other.
Walls crack, doors jam, and windows shatter.
That's why every house starts with a foundation.

This house is sinking into the ground 😳 Here's what happens without a foundation.
